ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Optional. Use only letters, numbers, and hyphens if you want to link directly to this section from elsewhere on the page.

SectionHeading.helper: Optional. Main heading shown above the two-column list. Formatted text and links are allowed.

IntroText.helper: Optional. Short intro shown below the heading. Formatted text and links are allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Science-backed practices that help people slow down, reconnect, and restore.

ListIcon.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

ValueProps.helper: Required. Add the list items in the order you want them displayed. If there is an odd number of items, the extra item will appear in the first column.

Title.helper: Required. Short title for this list item. Formatted text and links are allowed.

Description.helper: Optional. Short supporting description. Formatted text and links are allowed.
Description.placeholder: Guided nature-based sessions that support attention recovery, stress relief, and reconnection.
